description: A four channel stereo mixer with a level and a pan on each channel, a direct output per channel and a stereo mix output

params.text: Scales the stereo mix, silent at fully counter-clockwise and unchanged fully clockwise
Scales that channel, silent at fully counter-clockwise and unchanged fully clockwise
Places that channel in the stereo image, hard left at fully counter-clockwise, even between the two sides at the centre and hard right fully clockwise

inputs.text: Scales the stereo mix on top of the mix knob, 0V silencing it and 10V leaving it alone
Scales that channel on top of its level knob, 0V silencing it and 10V leaving it alone
Moves that channel's pan on top of its pan knob, -5V for hard left and 5V for hard right

outputs.text: The left side of the stereo mix
The right side of the stereo mix
That channel after its level knob and level input, before panning

notes: a channel is read only while a cable is patched to its input; with the input empty that channel contributes nothing and its direct output carries 0V
panning is a straight crossfade doubled: a channel at the centre reaches each side at the level its knob sets, and panned hard to one side it reaches that side at twice that level
